questoes.enunciado: Classify the cells indicated by the double arrows according to their shape.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Pseudounipolar neurons are exclusively sensory neurons that are mostly located in the peripheral nervous system. The cell body is spherical; the single process that emerges from the cell body bifurcates to form a central and peripheral axon.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The axon of a neuron can be distinguished from dendrites by its lack of Nissl and by the fact that it originates from a Nissl-free region of the cell body called the axon hillock.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The dura mater is composed of dense, irregular connective tissue and constitutes the outermost layer of the meninges.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Nissl bodies (Nissl substance) consists of large aggregations of rough endoplasmic reticulum and polysomes in neurons, hence the intense basophilic staining. This arrangement of protein synthetic organelles is unique to neurons and thus the term Nissl is used only for neurons.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The perineurium is a dense connective tissue-like wrapping which surrounds groups of axons in the peripheral nervous system, forming nerve fascicles.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure outlined in this image.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Meissner's corpuscles, encapsulated sensory receptors located in connective tissue dermal papillae of skin beneath the epithelium (epidermis), provide fine touch discrimination and are most concentrated in finger tips and lips. These corpuscles consist of Schwann cells, spiraling like a spring around an unmyelinated sensory axon. Deformation of the spring generates action potentials in the axon.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the arrows

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The arachnoid membrane is located between the dura mater and the pia mater. It encloses a space called the subarachnoid space, which contains cerebrospinal fluid.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure outlined in the image on the right.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This imagesshows an autonomic ganglion in Auerbach’s plexus (myenteric plexus) which contains motor neurons that innervate the smooth muscle of the outer muscle bands of the digestive tract.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells shown in this image.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This image shows astrocytes stained by a special gold technique. Astrocytes have numerous, branching processes and are present in both grey and white matter. Seen here are astrocytes extending processes to surround capillaries where they help regulate movement of materials in and out of the CNS.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The dendrites of a neuron can be distinguished from axons because there are multiple dendrites per cell and because dendrites contain Nissl substance and branch at acute angles.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cells indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Schwann cells are only found in the peripheral nervous system where they either surround axons or, as seen here, surround neuronal cells bodies. In this location, they are called satellite Schwann cells.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure outlined in this electron micrograph?

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This electron micrograph shows a portion of a neuronal cell body with a large Nissl body. Nissl is a unique association of rough endoplasmic reticulum and polyribosomes which appear as discrete structures in the cytoplasm by light microscopy. Nissl is prominent in the cell body and dendrites but is absent from axons.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by arrows

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. In this cross section of a peripheral nerve, the myelin sheaths appear as densely stained rings surrounding pale-staining axons. This tissue was fixed with osmium tetroxide and, thus, the lipid-rich myelin is well preserved. Clusters of smaller, unmyelinated axons are also visible.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by arrows

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. The perineurium is a dense connective tissue-like wrapping which surrounds groups of axons in the peripheral nervous system, forming fascicles.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. In hematoxylin and eosin stained sections, the cell bodies of glial cells are not well visualized. Glial cells are more numerous than neurons, and their nuclei, which are generally smaller than those of neurons, are present throughout central nervous tissue.

questoes.enunciado: Which of the labels is indicating a peripheral nerve?

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This image shows a peripheral nerve as it courses through connective tissue. The wavy appearance is a common feature of a nerve, as is the prominent, dense perineurium which clearly outlines this nerve fascicle within the connective tissue.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structures indicated by the arrows.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This section shows numerous, large myelinated axons in a peripheral nerve. The axon is the pale blue staining structure that is surrounded by the eosinophilic myelin. Most of the nuclei visible in this section are Schwann cell nuclei.

questoes.enunciado: Classify the cell indicated by the double arrow according to its shape.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This is a multipolar neuron because many processes originate from its cell body. These neurons provide a high degree of integration and have motor and association functions.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the cell indicated by the double arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. Schwann cells are the supporting cells in the peripheral nervous system. They surround and myelinate axons in peripheral nerves, as shown here. In ganglia, they surround neuronal cell bodies, where they are called satellite Schwann cells.

questoes.enunciado: Identify the structure indicated by the double arrow.

alternativas.feedback: CORRECT. This image shows a synapse which forms between a presynaptic terminal and a postsynaptic cell, in this case a dendritic spine. The presynaptic terminal contains neurotransmitter vesicles and an electron density at the membrane where it apposes the postsynaptic cell. This site, called the active zone, serves to anchor the vesicles at the presynaptic membrane.

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: CORRECT.  Pseudounipolar neurons are exclusively sensory neurons that are mostly located in the peripheral nervous system.  The cell body is spherical; the single process that emerges from the cell body bifurcates to form a central and peripheral axon.
